goal: Give the Claude Code Host the post-settlement GitHub projection the Pi Host already performs, so an opted-in tracker projection no longer depends on which Host settled the task.

acceptance.assertion: The Claude Code Host calls deriveGithubTerminalProjectionInput after settlement the way .pi-extension/imm-canary-work.ts already does, so a task settled under Claude Code produces the same opted-in terminal tracker projection as the same task settled under Pi.

Projection preconditions are unchanged and still enforced: only a fresh claimless done or stopped projection plus its exact terminal tombstone projects completed or not planned, Enrollment performs no GitHub projection, and the projection remains opt-in.
A tracker failure is reported separately and never becomes evidence, a Loop blocker, or a reason to repeat a Kernel mutation, matching the existing Pi behavior and the packaged contract.
